US Regulators Certify Boeing's 737 Max 10 Jet

US aviation regulators have certified Boeing's largest 737 Max jet, the Max 10, clearing a significant hurdle for the aircraft's entry into service. The certification comes nearly a decade after Boeing initially unveiled the plane, which had faced years of delays.
